Triage first-touch (central triage seat, daily round 2026-08-27, session `session_01Czs5tCwMymUvzB9QCA2yhH`): graded **`pm:queue`**, type **Task**, routed `domain:devx` (e2e test infrastructure — `e2e/console-boot-indicator.spec.ts`'s coverage rule). Measurement-first card, per the card's own honesty about what is NOT established: ⛔ no discriminator gets written until a candidate (geometry + rendered-text on the root, or adoption of the pixel-ledger rule for signed-in scenarios) is shown to stay RED on the genuinely-blank control arm and GREEN on the modal arm — the card's control-arm table is the acceptance harness, reuse it. Value is real and dated: the false positive bites the first signed-in scenario added to the campaign (already burned once as the #6570 episode), so this queues ahead of that extension rather than after it. Lane note: devx@objectui seat currently vacant.

Measurement-first per the 2026-08-27 triage: no discriminator ships until a candidate is shown RED on the genuinely-blank control arm and GREEN on the modal arm using the card's own control-arm harness; a measurement table with no spec change is a complete delivery if no candidate clears both arms. Stop on breach; explain in the report.
Container & model: M (measurement harness + one discriminator with two-arm ablation), `mode:subagent`, `model: opus`. Tier is this seat's explicit decision (no `dispatch-gates.mjs` in objectui).
Clause-②: no
Serial constraints cleared: on `origin/main` `eb33a8d4c` the spec is 388 lines, last moved by `b1a732b22` (#6565, 2026-08-26); no in-flight PR in either lane touches `e2e/`. #6570 (the fixture where this was measured) is closed not-planned and its comments carry the 20-boot distribution and the control-arm table. The console build this needs goes through the shared verify lock; batch siblings (#6640 test infra · #7183 `dist` project, PR #7291 up · #5174 docs ledger · #6214 README gate) are disjoint by construction.

ACCEPT — PR #7305 (round R40, PM review, against the 2026-08-27 triage ruling: measurement first, no discriminator until it is RED on the blank arm and GREEN on the modal arm).

- Measurement first, and it was decisive in a way the card did not predict: all three candidates clear the two decisive arms, so the portal survey (dispatch rule 6) became the selector — a modal Radix `DropdownMenu` reproduces the false positive with no overlay, the centre element is the bare `html`, and the portal-aware hit test (c) reads 87–91 uncovered there while (a) reads 0. Shipped (a): after the hit test has already said "uncovered", ask whether a named host still holds the sample point with rendered content inside, checking the whole ancestor chain for `display` / `visibility` / `opacity` / `content-visibility` so geometry is not mistaken for paint, and `innerText` rather than `textContent` so the answer is about layout, not source.
- The invariant the card and the claim both required holds by construction and is stated in the code: the discriminator is consulted only after the hit test fails, so it can only reclassify a sample the old rule called uncovered — the blank arm stays RED (91–92 uncovered, min channel 246 reproducing #6570's reading), the untouched arm stays 0.
- Ablation proves it: `const ok = hit || appStillHoldsPoint(cx, cy)` → `const ok = hit` (blob and count proven, restored to the HEAD blob with an empty diff), and every modal arm reads uncovered again; the probe under test was extracted from the spec file on disk, so the mutation really changed what ran.
- Two "not established" items from the card are now established and recorded in the spec's comment: the false positive is not confined to the dialog shape (modal `DropdownMenu`; `AlertDialog` / `Sheet` / `CommandDialog` are the dialog shape by source), and popovers, tooltips and toasts are benign because none covers the centre or is modal. The pixel ledger stays the arbiter in the harness and was rejected as the gate for a measured reason (one post-arm frame vs 91 DOM samples; a CDP session across five projects).
- File surface: one file, `e2e/console-boot-indicator.spec.ts`; the failure message now carries the host reading so a future red says which of the two cases it is. Gates: `type-check:e2e`, eslint, control-bytes, changeset (none owed), the on-disk e2e type-check pin (root vitest, 14/14), and the spec's own run 4/4. Declared deviations accepted: the container's Chromium build is older than the repo's pin and the CDN is blocked, so the local run used `executablePath` from a throwaway config outside the repo with `playwright.config.ts` untouched — CI's `Build & E2E` runs the file with the pinned browser and is already green on the head.

Landing: flip to ready + auto-merge when every check on `5e61d0e96` is success or skipped. Card closes on merge via `Fixes #6578`.
